evidence.title: How GPT-5 helped immunologist Derya Unutmaz solve a 3-year-old mystery

summary: Immunologist Derya Unutmaz used GPT-5 to crack a three-year-old research puzzle, showcasing AI's potential in advancing scientific discovery. The breakthrough highlights how advanced language models can accelerate problem-solving in complex fields like immunology.
title: GPT-5 Assists Immunologist in Solving Long-Standing Scientific Mystery
